## MathLib namespace

Library to manage fixed-point arithmetic.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare namespace MathLib
```

## Example


```ts
import { MathLib } from "@morpho-org/morpho-ts";

console.log(MathLib.wMulDown(MathLib.WAD, 42n));
```
